حَبْرَةٌ : see حُبُورٌ, in three places. ―
-b2- Also Extraordinariness (مُبَالَغَةٌ) in a thing that is described as beautiful. (K.) [See 1.] ―
-b3- A musical performance, or concert, instrumental or vocal or both, (سَمَاعٌ,) in Paradise; (Zj, K;) agreeably with which signification Zj explains [the verb in] the verse of the Kur [xxx. 14, or xliii. 70]: (TA:) and any sweet melody. (K.) ＝
-A2- See also حِبِرٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
